title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 (GLP-1) Receptor Agonists for Type 2 Diabetes
summary: Prior authorization for GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy requires confirmed diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, documented baseline HbA1c >= 7.0% within the past 90 days, and documented failure or contraindication/intolerance to Metformin at maximally tolerated dose for at least 90 days.

sections.title: Initial Authorization Criteria
sections.content:
Initial approval of GLP-1 receptor agonists (e.g., Ozempic, Trulicity, Mounjaro) requires:
1. Confirmed diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (ICD-10 E11 series).
2. Baseline Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) level >= 7.0% (or target not achieved per clinical guidelines) documented within the prior 90 days.
3. Trial of Metformin for at least 90 days with inadequate glycemic control, OR documented clinical contraindication (e.g. eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m2, severe lactic acidosis history) or documented gastrointestinal intolerance.
4. Patient is not taking another GLP-1 receptor agonist or DPP-4 inhibitor concurrently.

sections.title: Exclusions
sections.content: Coverage is excluded when used solely for weight loss in non-diabetic patients without specific plan weight-management riders, or for Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus.

criteria.title: Confirmed Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Diagnosis
criteria.description: Patient has an established diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
criteria.required_evidence: Clinical note documenting diagnosis of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) or ICD-10 E11 code.

criteria.title: Elevated HbA1c (>= 7.0%) within 90 days
criteria.description: Laboratory value of HbA1c >= 7.0% documented within the preceding 90 days.
criteria.required_evidence: Lab value showing HbA1c percentage and recent date within 90 days.

criteria.title: Metformin Trial (>= 90 days) or Documented Contraindication
criteria.description: Documented trial of metformin at >= 1000 mg/day for at least 90 days with failure to reach glycemic target, OR documented intolerance or contraindication (e.g. eGFR < 30).
criteria.required_evidence: Note detailing metformin trial duration and intolerance or insufficient response.

criteria.title: Absence of DPP-4 Inhibitor Dual Therapy Exclusion
criteria.description: Patient is not concurrently prescribed or taking a DPP-4 inhibitor (e.g. sitagliptin, linagliptin).
criteria.required_evidence: Medication list showing discontinuation or absence of DPP-4 inhibitors.
